process_memory_mib.interpretation: [V] The depth-13/digits-3/ring-65536 complete block target process peaked at 9834 MiB -- well under one 80GB A100 and lower than the depth-16 baseline's 12920 MiB peak, consistent with fewer RNS towers (14 vs 17).

contamination.effect: [U] Preflight showed 4 pre-existing compute processes on physical GPU 4 (unlike the clean depth-9/depth-10 launches), and whole-host load was heavy throughout (other physical GPUs observed at 100% utilization from other tenants). Whole-GPU memory, utilization, and exact wall-clock throughput cannot be attributed only to this run. The target PID's process-memory samples and correctness result remain usable.

limitations: [U] nvidia-smi process memory is allocation-level telemetry, not a live-ciphertext object census.
[U] This is one complete block at T=103, not the chained 12-block graph or released task head.
[U] It proves that this block fits one 80GB A100 at MULT_DEPTH=13; it does not prove that a future composition keeps the same bounded live set.

[U] Timing (4662.22s total encrypted evaluation vs the depth-16 baseline's 6281.75s) is directional only -- both runs were co-tenant-contaminated and this is a single sample, not the two-to-three repeats required by docs/roadmap.md for a reported stable speedup.
